study.title: The carboligation reaction of acetohydroxyacid synthase II: Steady-state intermediate distributions in wild type and mutants by NMR

question: Does Table2 total AHA population/turnover inference and Fig4 support reconstructible product-specific net constants in the Trp464Leu mixed-acceptor arm?
conclusion: Retain the source total-product parameters and its four explicitly approximate product-specific estimates. The source estimates order AHB above AL at both later stages, but the inspected primary does not supply the branch derivation. No computable branched kinetic fit is established.

sources.inspection: Complete relevant PDF pages 2-6 visually inspected: Methods, Fig2/Eqs2-9/Table1, Table2 and both footnotes, Fig4 and its caption, Discussion/Eq10. Fig4B has distinct ALThDP/AHBThDP labels; no numerical peak integrals are printed.

inherited_context.scope: Reuses source identity and general preparation/method context only; Met250Ala parameters and reaction conditions do not transfer.

constructs.identity: Source-named E.coli AHAS isozymeII, ilvG2096-derived sequence with pRSET N-terminal hexahistidine fusion on the large catalytic subunit; source pRSET-GM or pQEV-GM expression and Ni-NTA purification as holoenzyme. Exact plasmid choice for this row and complete assay sequence are not supplied.
constructs.scope: Source-named hexahistidine-fused study construct; no exact assayed sequence, batch identity, WT parameter transfer or mutant structure.

condition.scope: One mixed-substrate condition. The AL branch row labeled (Pyr+Pyr) to AL remains in this 50/50 mM mixture; it is not the separate 100 mM pyruvate-only row.
condition.saturation_handling: Source Eqs2-9 assume substrate saturation; Methods corrects unsubstituted ThDP for pyruvate nonsaturation using Michaelis-Menten. Do not infer full saturation from the nominal concentration.

turnover.source: PDFp2 general enzyme assays;PDFp3 Table1 footnotes;PDFp4 Table2 and dagger-footnote
turnover.endpoint: Table2 total acetohydroxyacid formation, AHA = AL + AHB.
turnover.method_scope: General enzyme assays refer to earlier methods. Table1 distinguishes acetoin-colorimetric kinetic measurements from simultaneous AHB/AL competition measurements. The exact total-product analytical combination used for this Table2 mixed row is not specified separately.
turnover.normalization: Source per-site turnover convention, assuming two sites in a 138-kDa heterotetramer; no tetramer-total conversion.
turnover.recipe: General enzyme assay: 0.1 M KPi pH7.6, 10 mM MgCl2, 0.1 mM ThDP and 75 uM FAD, with the Table2 mixed-substrate exception.

NMR.source: PDFp2 Methods;PDFp4 Fig3 caption;PDFp5 Fig4 caption and panel B
NMR.method: Rapid mixing, acid quench, denatured-protein removal, then 1H NMR of protein-free solution. Covalent derivatives use C6-prime-H integrals; ThDP uses C2-H.
NMR.pre_mixing_reconstitution: 15 mg/mL hexahistidine-fused enzyme, 250 uM FAD, 10 mM Mg2+ and active-site-equimolar ThDP in 0.1 M KPi pH7.6.
NMR.quench: Equal volume of 12.5% (w/v) trichloroacetic acid / 1 M DCl in D2O. Methods use 0.1-10 s to assess steady state; Fig4 follows Fig3, whose caption specifies 300 ms.
NMR.display_scope: Qualitative source peak assignments only. Fig4A and B fingerprint regions have different 5-fold and 8-fold zoom; peak heights are not numerical populations or product fluxes.

conditional_model_check.assumption: If both branch k-prime-4 entries were net pseudo-first-order hazards from the same measured HEThDP pool at this mixture, J_i=k_i*[HEThDP] would require k_total=k_AL+k_AHB.
conditional_model_check.rounded_center_check: The source centers would give 310 versus approximately 120+360=480 s^-1.
conditional_model_check.conclusion: These printed centers cannot be reused unchanged as that exact common-pool model. The missing branch normalization and approximate errors prevent a source-error or statistical-inconsistency conclusion.
conditional_model_check.alternative_denominator_status: Unresolved; do not invent conditional/pathway-specific populations or rescale constants to close the equation.

limits: Forward-net constants combine true forward rates and commitment to product rather than reversal; they are dependent source inferences, not independent measurements of elementary arrows.
Acid-quench species can pool forms with and without noncovalently associated substrates/products. Fig4 is not a microscopic state inventory or product-flux measurement.
Fig2 has a single generic acceptor/product route; it is not an explicit branched diagram. Fig4 and Table2 support alternative products without supplying a full kinetic branch model.

Source Discussion and Eq10 keep reversible carboligation and liberation, with acceptor binding and product diffusion unresolved. No residue energy, single selectivity-determining step or numerical design target follows.

Source cumulative-specificity/kinetic-proofreading explanation is speculation, not established by these estimates. Fig5 is yeast-based hypothetical geometry; Fig6 concerns WT, not a Trp464Leu observed arrangement.
No assayed sequence authentication, isotope mapping, exact product stereochemistry, project experiment, independent human review, protected registry admission or design-performance claim.
